title: Exact Frobenius fibres of constructible rational Weil sheaves
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, an integer $a\ge1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$. Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme and put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$. Let $\Qlb$ be the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Use constructible $\Qlb$-sheaves in the heart of [def-weil-constructible-heart], with Weil structures and commuting morphisms as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. For a closed point $x\in|Y_0|$ choose an embedding $\kappa(x)\hookrightarrow k$ and the associated geometric point $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}k\to Y$. The fibre $\mathcal H_{\bar x}$ means the finite-dimensional rational point fibre and its local geometric Frobenius $F_x$ of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. Then a short exact sequence of such Weil sheaves induces a short exact sequence
$$0\longrightarrow\mathcal F'_{\bar x}\longrightarrow\mathcal F_{\bar x}\longrightarrow\mathcal F''_{\bar x}\longrightarrow0$$
of finite-dimensional $\Qlb$-vector spaces, and the two induced maps commute with $F_x$.
